{{Quote|Let's just say you're not the only one with a mole inside the Bounty Hunters' Guild.''"<br />"''Don't listen to 'im boss&mdash;it had nothing to do with me!|Denov denies working with the Stroms after Rolu mentions their mole|<ref name="BFatSoF" />}}
'''Denov''' was a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Denov worked secretly as a mole for the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], providing him with information on [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] from the Guild and aiding him in finding his targets. The Snivvian helped Fett locate the ancient [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury cruiser]] ''[[Reverie]]'' when the Mandalorian was searching for the [[Arachedron sculpture]] located onboard. When Fett reached the ''Reverie'', the mole provided him with directions through the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] until Fett was captured by the bounty hunting brothers [[Edo Strom|Edo]] and [[Rolu Strom]], who also claimed to have a mole in the Guild.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Just give me the information I asked for, Denov.|Fett asks Denov for information on the ''Reverie''|<ref name="BFatSoF" />}}
Denov was a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] who worked as a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. While serving the Guild, Denov also secretly worked for the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] as a mole, providing him with information on the Guild. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Fett contacted Denov via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] after ambushing the bounty hunting brothers [[Edo Strom|Edo]] and [[Rolu Strom]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dolva Prime/Legends|Dolva Prime]]. The Mandalorian had taken a fake copy of the artifact known as the [[Arachedron sculpture]] from the two and discovered a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] inside showing the location of the true sculpture to be aboard a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] named the ''[[Reverie]]'', which he needed Denov to locate.<ref name="BFatSoF" />

Fett later contacted Denov via hologram while [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|ship]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], and asked for an update on the missing ''Reverie''. Denov claimed to have found it but then informed Fett of four new [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] that the Guild had yet to post, allowing the Mandalorian a head start on them. Uninterested, Fett asked for information on the ''Reverie'', which Denov reluctantly provided, detailing the ship's history as a luxury [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] followed by its destruction due to cut costs concerning [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]]. The Snivvian then told Fett that the ship was currently located in a [[ship graveyard]] located at the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], where it was unlikely he would find it without having to face off against [[Scavenger/Legends|junkers]] and scrap [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], if at all. Unperturbed, Fett made his way to the graveyard after refusing to reveal to Denov what he was looking for in the ship.<ref name="BFatSoF" />

The mole then used old concept designs of the ship to try and guide Fett through the ''Reverie'' to its vault; however, the Mandalorian was attacked by many small [[Arachedron]]s en route and then captured by the Strom brothers. The brothers tied Fett up and then explained they too had a mole in the Guild who had helped them find the ''Reverie'', at which point Denov denied being the brothers' mole before they switched off Fett's [[Comm unit/Legends|communication device]]. Denov did not contact Fett again throughout the rest of his mission, which ended with the Mandalorian abandoning the sculpture, as it was too risky to escape with.<ref name="BFatSoF" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I hate to think of you all alone out there.|Denov speaks to Fett over the comm|<ref name="BFatSoF" />}}
Denov was willing to work for the infamous bounty hunter Boba Fett and betray the Bounty Hunters' Guild while he was a member of it. Despite the Mandalorian's reputation, the Snivvian doubted Fett would be able to find the ''Reverie'' and retrieve the prize he sought within, although the mole still directed Fett there when ordered. Denov cared in some form for Fett, or at least pretended to, claiming to hate thinking about Fett being all alone inside the ruined luxury cruiser. When the Strom brothers claimed to have a mole, Denov tried desperately to persuade Fett that it was a different Guild member.<ref name="BFatSoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denov first appeared as a hologram in ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Boba Fett and the Ship of Fear]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novella]] written by [[Jeremy Barlow]], penciled by [[Daxiong]], and released in [[2011]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars Adventures]]'' series. The novella does not make clear the Snivvian's gender or if it was actually Denov who acted as the Stroms' mole.
